column1: 21426§destination§ˌdestɪˈneɪʃn§The tourists rest there and then go to various destinations.§游客们在那里稍事休息，然后去往不同的**目的地**。§
21427§welfare§ˈwelfeə(r)§The office deals with all matters related to student welfare.§该办公室专门处理与学生**福利**相关的各种事务。§
21428§envisage§ɪnˈvɪzɪdʒ§It's just a chance for you to say anything about the equipment and problems you envisage.§这对你来说是个机会，你可以就设备和**想到**的问题谈一谈自己的看法。§
21429§binoculars§bɪˈnɒkjələz§The park's viewing shelter is a favourite spot for bird watchers who can use it to spy through binoculars.§公园的野鸟观测遮蔽处是鸟类观赏者最喜爱的去处，在那儿他们可以使用**双筒望远镜**来观赏鸟类。§

21430§spoilage§ˈspɔɪlɪdʒ§Bitterness, he says, alerts us of toxins in the food, while sourness warns us of spoilage and saltiness signals the presence of minerals.§他说，苦味提醒我们食物中有毒素，酸味提醒我们食品已**变质**，而咸味代表存在矿物质。§

21431§misconception§ˌmɪskənˈsepʃn§Some people often have a misconception that keeping in good shape needs to be on a diet or even not to eat anything; in fact this idea is wrong.§有些人经常有种**错误想法**，认为好身材需要节食甚至靠不吃东西来保持，事实上这个想法是错的。§

21432§vegetation§ˌvedʒəˈteɪʃn§There is more and more vegetation disappearing every year and we can never find it again.§每年都有越来越多的**植物**灭绝，我们永远也找不到它们了。§改例句：vegetation 不可数，are 改 is、them 改 it；couldn't find them forever 不通，改 can never find it again

21433§conceptual§kənˈseptʃuəl§There is only a conceptual framework of the play which needs the actors to develop it themselves.§这部戏到现在为止只有一个**概念**框架，需要演员自行发挥。§改例句：framework 前缺冠词 a；the actor 与 themselves 不一致，改 the actors，develop 后补宾语 it
21434§modification§ˌmɒdɪfɪˈkeɪʃn§Knowledge of the ill effects of tobacco can lead to a modification in smoking behaviour.§了解吸烟对健康的损害能够**改变**人们吸烟的行为。§
21435§erroneous§ɪˈrəʊniəs§It seems that the boy is under the erroneous impression that the pretty girl is in love with him.§看起来这个男孩子是**误**以为那个漂亮女孩爱上他了。§
21436§robust§rəʊˈbʌst§Some of the misconceptions are erroneous, more robust but also accessible to modification.§一些错误的想法是不正确的，是比较**顽固**的，但是仍然可以进行修改。§
21437§immense§ɪˈmens§The scope of the problem facing the world's cities is immense.§全世界的城市面临**很多**方面的问题。§
21438§baron§ˈbærən§The Frenchman Baron Pierre de Coubertin, an educator and scholar, founded the modern Olympics.§法国教育家及学者皮埃尔·德·顾拜旦**男爵**创办了现代奥运会。§

21439§independence§ˌɪndɪˈpendəns§With the independence of much of Asia and Africa after 1945, it was assumed that economic progress would rapidly lead to the disappearance or assimilation of many small-scale societies.§1945年后，随着亚洲和非洲很多国家的**独立**，人们推断经济进步将会很快导致许多小型社会的消失或者被同化。§
21440§intense§ɪnˈtens§Large thunderclouds generate the intense electrical fields that cause lightning flashes.§巨大的雷雨云产生**极强**的电磁场，从而形成闪电。§
21441§withdraw§wɪðˈdrɔː§ATMs are extremely useful as they enable you to withdraw cash from your account whenever you want.§自动取款机非常有用，因为它可以使你随时从账户内**取款**。§
21442§sceptical§ˈskeptɪkl§People become less sceptical and more optimistic when the weather is sunny.§人们在晴朗的日子里会变得少**猜忌**并且更乐观。§
21443§flicker§ˈflɪkə(r)§The light flickers quite badly and it's giving me headaches.§灯光**闪**得非常厉害，弄得我头疼。§
21444§cord§kɔːd§This process could be speeded up by wrapping a cord around the drill and pulling on each end.§这个过程可以通过拉缠绕在钻头两端的**线**来加快速度。§
21445§lower§ˈləʊə(r)§The lower end of the valley has become one huge camp site.§这条河谷**下游**的出口处已经变成了一个巨大的营地。§
21446§primary§ˈpraɪməri§The primary reason for advertising is to sell more goods.§做广告的**首要**目的是要售出更多的货物。§
21447§exhaustion§ɪgˈzɔːstʃən§The runner collapsed from exhaustion.§那个奔跑的人因为**极度疲劳**而昏倒了。§
21448§coincide§ˌkəʊɪnˈsaɪd§My religious beliefs don't coincide with yours.§我的宗教信仰与你的不**一致**。§改译文：coincide 是「一致」，原译「不同」括不出这个词，改成「不一致」
21449§mess§mes§The celebration locale is in a mess.§欢庆场地**一片狼藉**。§
21450§design§dɪˈzaɪn§Architecture is the art and science of designing buildings and structures.§建筑学是一门**设计**建筑物及其结构的艺术科学。§
21451§insist§ɪnˈsɪst§We do not insist on any prerequisites for this course.§对于这一课程，我们不**一定需要**什么先决条件。§
21452§crew§kruː§The rescue crew is still looking for survivors.§救援**队**仍然在寻找生还者。§
21453§geographical§ˌdʒiːəˈgræfɪkl§The new geographical report covers a wide range of geographical area.§新的**地理学**报告涵盖了大范围的地理区域。§
21454§indigenous§ɪnˈdɪdʒənəs§The emu is indigenous to Australia.§鸸鹋是澳大利亚**土生土长**的鸟类。§
21455§consistent§kənˈsɪstənt§The survey results are entirely consistent with our earlier research.§调查的结果与我们早期的研究结果完全**一致**。§
21456§sympathetic§ˌsɪmpəˈθetɪk§Lena just needed someone who would lend a sympathetic ear to her.§丽娜只需要有人能**同情地**听她诉诉苦。§改译文：原译文没译出 sympathetic，加「同情地」
21457§personalize§ˈpɜːsənəlaɪz§All the towels and cups were personalized with the initial names of the owners.§所有的毛巾和杯子上都**标注**了物主姓名的首字母。§
21458§incompatible§ˌɪnkəmˈpætəbl§Any new operating system that is incompatible with existing ones has little chance of being used.§任何与现有的操作系统**不兼容**的新操作系统都几乎得不到使用。§
21459§predominate§prɪˈdɒmɪneɪt§Red colour predominates in clothes of this brand.§这个品牌的衣服，红色**占据了主流**。§
21460§complexity§kəmˈpleksəti§Students in our class are all astonished by the great complexity of this event.§我们班里的所有同学都对这次事件的**复杂性**感到震惊。§
21461§terrestrial§təˈrestriəl§Scientists compared terrestrial animals with marine species to understand how each group adapts to its environment.§科学家们将**陆生**动物与海洋物种进行比较，以了解它们各自如何适应所处的环境。§补例句
21462§commission§kəˈmɪʃn§He now has a new commission to design a glass sculpture for the headquarters of a pizza company.§他现在有新的**委托事务**，为一家比萨公司的总部大楼设计一件玻璃雕塑。§
21463§beware§bɪˈweə(r)§There are some venomous snakes to beware of in this area.§该地区有一些毒蛇，要**小心**。§
21464§compensation§ˌkɒmpenˈseɪʃn§The company was paid a sum of money by an insurance agent as compensation for its loss in a fire.§那家公司从保险公司那里得到一笔火灾损失**赔偿金**。§
21465§issue§ˈɪʃuː§They care about environmental issues but their concern does not affect their spending habits.§他们关心环境**问题**，但这种关心并没有影响他们的消费习惯。§
21466§finite§ˈfaɪnaɪt§The finite fossil fuel reserves will hinder the development of a country.§**有限**的矿物燃料储备将阻碍一个国家的发展。§
21467§curly§ˈkɜːli§The package was decorated with curly ribbon.§包裹用**卷**丝带装饰了起来。§
21468§redress§rɪˈdres§The government is taking measures to redress these abuses of power.§政府正采取措施**纠正**这些滥用职权行为。§
21469§swallow§ˈswɒləʊ§One should never swallow his words.§人们应**坚守诺言**。§
21470§hasty§ˈheɪsti§It is unwise to make a hasty conclusion.§**草率**地得出结论是不明智的。§
21471§geometry§dʒiˈɒmətri§Reading novels during geometry class is a misuse of your time.§在**几何**课上看小说是滥用你自己的时间。§
21472§stuff§stʌf§The premium coffee like the stuff we're drinking now is from a type of bean called Arabica.§特级咖啡，就像我们现在喝的**东西**，是由一种叫阿拉比卡的咖啡豆制成的。§改译文：原译文没译出 stuff，加「东西」
21473§landward§ˈlændwəd§It is landward access, which is productive of goods for export and which demands imports, that is critical.§**近陆**的入口非常重要，它既能够生产出口货物，对进口也有需求。§
21474§vigorous§ˈvɪgərəs§The small group of the survivors was to become a vigorous, self-sustaining island population.§那一小队幸存者成了**精力充沛**、自力更生的岛上居民。§
21475§subordinate§səˈbɔːdɪnət§He was always friendly to his subordinates.§他一向对**下属**和蔼可亲。§
21476§correspond§ˌkɒrəˈspɒnd§This person's characteristics correspond with the witness' description.§这个人的特征与证人的描述**相符**。§改例句：witness' 后缺空格
21477§farewell§ˌfeəˈwel§We bid our old friends farewell.§我们向老友们**告别**。§
21478§adjacent§əˈdʒeɪsnt§People living in houses adjacent to the airport are tormented by noise for years.§住在机场**附近**的居民常年受到噪音的折磨。§
21479§charity§ˈtʃærəti§I have some things to give to the local charity in a box in the front room.§前厅有个盒子，里面装了些东西，我准备捐给当地的**慈善机构**。§
21480§comedy§ˈkɒmədi§I really like to watch some of the old comedy shows.§我真想看一些以前的**喜剧**表演。§
21481§gorgeous§ˈgɔːdʒəs§The garden with azaleas is gorgeous.§花园里杜鹃花盛开，**绚丽多彩**。§
21482§recommend§ˌrekəˈmend§As treatment for back pain the clinic mainly recommends relaxation therapy.§至于背部疼痛的治疗，诊所主要**推荐**采用放松疗法。§
21483§survive§səˈvaɪv§For most animal species, individuals are less likely to survive and reproduce.§对于大多数动物物种来说，个体似乎不太可能**存活**以及繁衍后代。§
21484§grim§grɪm§We gradually found his laugh grim.§我们渐渐觉得他的笑声**让人讨厌**。§
21485§apparatus§ˌæpəˈreɪtəs§This apparatus has been thoroughly tested.§这套**设备**已经过全面测试。§
21486§dome§dəʊm§The bottom of the can is shaped like a dome to resist the internal pressure.§罐子的底部呈内凹的**圆顶**形，这是为了承受来自罐内的压力。§
21487§formal§ˈfɔːml§They held the first formal international meeting on the subject.§他们就这一主题举行了第一届**正式**的国际会议。§
21488§explore§ɪkˈsplɔː(r)§Architects began to explore ways of creating buildings using the latest technology.§建筑师开始**探索**利用最新技术来建造房屋的方法。§
21489§extension§ɪkˈstenʃn§These temporary hive extensions contained frames of empty comb for the bees to fill with honey.§这些临时**加上去**的蜂箱中放有空的蜂巢结构的架子，用于让蜜蜂存放蜂蜜。§
21490§consist§kənˈsɪst§Each hour consists of 50-minute tuition and a 10-minute break.§每小时的内容**包括**50分钟的讲解和10分钟的休息。§改译文：原译「安排是」不对应 consist of（包括，由…组成），改成「包括」
21491§brew§bruː§When there is a thunderstorm brewing, some people complain of the air being heavy and of feeling irritable.§当暴风雨**即将来临**，一些人抱怨空气沉闷而且感觉烦躁。§
21492§sacrifice§ˈsækrɪfaɪs§Linda's parents made sacrifices so that she could have a good education abroad.§为了让琳达能在国外接受良好的教育，琳达的父母做出了**牺牲**。§

21493§degenerate§dɪˈdʒenəreɪt§Similarly, although at least some cetaceans have taste buds, the nerves serving these have degenerated or are rudimentary.§同样，尽管至少一些鲸鱼是有味蕾的，但是控制这些味蕾的神经已经**退化**了或者根本就没有充分发展。§
21494§intelligent§ɪnˈtelɪdʒənt§The most intelligent students do additional reading to supplement the material in the textbook.§最**聪明**的学生通过课外阅读来补充课本的内容。§
